title: Invoke quick_validate only with an initialized skill directory
trigger_preconditions: The skill validator is a path-only utility and does not declare a help-mode contract.
failure_signature: A combined help probe passed --help to quick_validate, which treated it as a path and returned SKILL.md not found.
candidate_workaround: Initialize a phase-local skill first, then pass its exact directory to quick_validate.
recurrence_guard: Do not assume every local script supports argparse help; inspect its usage or invoke it only with its documented positional path.
rollback: Give the failed help probe zero skill-validation credit and leave every global skill untouched.
scope_boundary: Phase-local skill validation only; no global installation, full-suite, scientific, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
